items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: And later years I had a lot of piano players like Lil Willie, Georgie, Parker, Red Caillou and all those fellas. And I used to sing with them at house parties.

ctx.x: It's still there. I think you're going to tear that place down now. It's still there? I think maybe there's one out there on St. Peter.

St. Peter and Liberty, yeah. The auditorium. That's right. And at that time, we used to call it Ella Cole's Church. And oh, they had some wonderful singing. I heard preachers like Blind Frank, which was one of the greatest preachers they had in New Orleans as I knew of at that time. But I used to have all these choirs, I used to love that. I used to love to go to church and hear this singing. I didn't know much about the church but I loved the singing, you know? But what really inspired me to play music, I was, I…
He wasn't just a blues man. He played any type of piano.
